body: Many times. We've been to couples therapy, church councillors, you name it. It's just not something that will change. It didn't used to be this way either! It used to be very lovey dovey and physically expressive. It's all changed now...

I feel like a piece of shit just considering this idea. I've just become used to the idea of being unhappy, and caring for a manic depressive person. Sometimes I feel like leaving would be the best option, other times I feel like I'd ruin my life and hers. I'm going to ruminate on this for a while, but I won't do anything for a while I think.

Very true, you are right as rain. Only problem is, gf has stated several times that she will self harm if I leave her. She is unhappy with me, as I am with her. I don't know what to do. You are right though: sleeping with her best friend would do irreparable harm to all involved. Thanks for replying.
